authority_separation.relationship: APPEND_ONLY_ADDENDUM__original stays the record of what was pre-registered before the audit
authority_separation.effective_condition: takes effect only for future M1 work; nothing here retroactively rewrites the original gates

timing_attestation.caveat_source: the amendments were derived from the PPC-PTB-1A correctness pre-audit (probe run 2026-11-12), which executed NO arm-A/B/C comparison, NO benchmark, NO self-play and NO model training
what_had_already_run: real-engine one-turn ground-truth probes on synthetic legal states
depth-1 traversal coverage on 7 frozen roots
wall-clock micro-measurements of the certificate predicate
what_had_NOT_run: A vs B vs C comparison

original.intent_as_written: run the default experiment set on a 6x6 board

problems_found: S3 as written does not say HOW boardSize is applied, and the two paths are not equivalent
measured (P5-A): raw mutation {...DEFAULT_CONFIG, boardSize:6} is REJECTED by validateGameConfig with two issues -- hole rect (7,8,2) out of bounds and mouseStart (7,8) out of bounds
measured (P5-A): withBoardSize(DEFAULT_CONFIG, 6) is ACCEPTED (ok=true) and re-derives hole to (3,4) -- but it keeps boxCount=12 and pileCount=4 from the 10x10 defaults

density consequence at 6x6: 36 cells - 4 hole - 4 tunnel = 28 free cells, against 16 fixed obstacles -> 57% of the playable area obstructed, versus 16/92 = 17% at 10x10; that is a different game, not a smaller one
H1 and the frozen learned leaves are normalized on the default 10x10 map, so a 6x6 run measures a different game AND a different evaluator

amended.requirement: S3 is now a NEGATIVE control: a 6x6 configuration produced by raw boardSize mutation MUST be rejected by validateGameConfig, with an explicit reason, no crash, no partially-initialized state and no benchmark row
amended.pass_condition: rejection observed and recorded verbatim (hole out of bounds + start out of bounds)

additional_entry.delta: 6x6 legal small map built via withBoardSize (layout re-derived), with obstacle counts explicitly re-scaled
additional_entry.measured_precondition: withBoardSize(DEFAULT_CONFIG,6) validates ok=true today, so S3b is REACHABLE -- but only after boxCount/pileCount are either scaled or held with the resulting density reported

problems_found: no explicit legality gate: 'sparse void pattern' is not a specification, so two runs can use different maps and still be called S5

the mouse-hole contract diverges on hand-drawn maps: the ENGINE wins on board terrain (targetCell.type === 'mouse_hole') while evaluation, RULE-B and the carrying BFS use the config.mouseHole rectangle
'tunnelCorners may be empty' silently changes the mouse's mobility graph and the cat's blocking options

amended.requirement: S5 must ship an EXPLICIT, versioned layout artifact (cell-by-cell terrain, hole cells, tunnel corners, start cells) plus a legality gate that runs BEFORE any measurement
legality_gate_checks: every mouse_hole terrain cell is inside the configured hole rect and vice versa (else the layout is INVALID)
all four tunnel corners are either present and consistent with config, or the layout is explicitly declared tunnel-free
start cells are enterable and mutually reachable under the real rules
the void pattern leaves at least one legal action for whichever side moves first
the carrying path from every reachable cell to a hole is either blocked or well-defined (no ambiguity at the rect boundary)

amendments.original: leaf-level proof: mouse wins in-turn iff carrying && carryingHoleDist <= mouseMovesLeft; cat wins in-turn iff catWalkDist <= catMovesLeft (walk-only => conservative)
problems_found: the mouse side is NOT an iff: carryingHoleDist is computed on a graph that permits entering the trap cell, and stepping on the trap ends the turn with zero moves left
measured: 22 false PROVEN_SAME_TURN_WIN verdicts in 123 candidate states on the default map (P1-A)
the cat side is NOT an iff either: catWalkDist only prices walk-only routes, so a box push can reach the mouse in fewer real steps
one side is unsound-as-written and the other is merely incomplete; a single 'iff' wording hides that asymmetry

mouse_side.predicate: phase==Playing && currentPlayer==Mouse && mouseMovesLeft>0 && mouseHasButter && trapAwareCarryingDist(mouse) <= mouseMovesLeft
required_corrections: the trap cell is removed from the graph (stepping on it forfeits the turn)
the hole targets are board cells of terrain mouse_hole, not the config rect
tunnel cells stay excluded (carrying forbids tunnel entry)
mouse_side.strength_after_correction: EXACT (necessary and sufficient) inside the mouse's own turn, because the graph is static for the whole turn
mouse_side.empirical: 400/400 agreements with the real engine, 0 disagreements, 0 witness-replay failures (P1-B)

cat_side.reason: walk-only BFS excludes box pushes, so the true minimum step count can be strictly smaller; the certificate proves a capture but can never prove its absence
cat_side.empirical: 0 false PROVEN in 3011 checked states; 0 missed wins in a 400-state near-miss band and 304 push-only candidates (P1-C) -- soundness is confirmed, incompleteness is a THEORETICAL hazard that this map did not exhibit

three_valued_output.PROVEN_SAME_TURN_WIN: a complete legal action witness exists that reaches a terminal win inside the current turn
three_valued_output.NOT_PROVEN: this detector found no proof; a winning line may still exist
three_valued_output.UNKNOWN: the predicate could not be evaluated (budget, incomplete state, unmodelled randomness, layout inconsistency)

forbidden: emitting PROVEN from a distance comparison alone

problems_found: the fixed-depth search evaluates its horizon with the SAME static H1 leaf that the certificate is meant to supplement, so it cannot serve as an independent oracle for one-turn terminal truth
requiring the certificate to reproduce the old static leaf value would reject exactly the new information (a decided win) that motivates the whole step
a self-referential oracle turns a correctness question into a consistency question

amended.definition: for each leaf, exhaustively enumerate the current actor's own legal action sequences through the REAL engine transitions and decide whether a terminal win is reachable inside that turn
acceptance: MISSED_WIN_COUNT is reported but is NOT a failure for the cat side (sufficient-only)
for the mouse side, MISSED_WIN_COUNT == 0 because the corrected predicate claims exactness
UNKNOWN is never counted as correct
amended.C2_secondary: search value / plan / budget effects are a SEPARATE question, evaluated after C2 primary passes, and are never used to establish correctness

amendments.reason: the audit produced two facts the original gate could not express

added.requirement: report, per root, how many leaves the certificate actually fires on AND whether it DISCRIMINATES leaves of the same root
added.measured_baseline: 7 frozen roots, 1044 leaves at depth-1 traversal, 1044 mouse / 0 cat, 322 proven, 0 roots where the verdict separates the root's candidate moves
added.consequence: a certificate that fires on ALL or NONE of a root's leaves cannot change the chosen move; it can only relabel the value. Any playing-strength claim must clear this bar first

added.requirement: the cat-side certificate may only be counted as useful if cat-to-move leaves exist at the budget being evaluated
added.measured_baseline: AUTHORITY_100MS completedDepth = 1 (20/20) on both authority roots; at depth 1 the frozen fixed-depth lane recorded 453 mouse leaves and 0 cat leaves. Therefore the cat-side certificate has ZERO firing sites at the 100ms production budget
added.consequence: cat-side M1 work is gated on D2 becoming reachable; do not budget it as a D1 win

added.requirement: the certificate may not write +/-MATE_SCORE into the leaf value until mate distance, TT EXACT semantics, CHANCE semantics and truncation propagation are separately audited

unchanged_frozen_semantics: arms A / B / C definitions and the NO_NEW_HYBRID_CANDIDATE verdict for C
